task: ACCT-R-03 (ranked ACCT-F13) / pile 0091-m-lists-2 — the Chart-of-Accounts 'Merge accounts' action was deactivate-only. CoaBatchActions.handleMerge looped the catalog DEACTIVATE endpoint over every source account, so child accounts kept pointing at an archived parent and every config pointer that DESIGNATES an account for future postings (catalogs.items.default_income/expense_account_id, catalogs.account_role_bindings, accounting.chart_of_accounts_roles, accounting.expense_category_account_map, accounting.banking_rules, accounting.escrow_accounts, fixed_assets.asset_classes, finance.loans, banking.bank_accounts.ledger_account_id) kept designating an account nobody could post to. catalogs.account_merge_records — required by blueprint MUST 3.18.4.3 step 5 — did not exist in any migration, so no record of a merge was ever written. This block adds the real merge: POST /api/v1/catalogs/accounts/:id/merge (Owner-only per 3.18.12, entity-GUC scoped, one lockstep transaction) reparents children, remounts every config pointer same-entity, writes the append-only merge record, archives (never deletes) the source, emits catalogs.account_merged (critical) + the WF-064 owner-notification workflow event. Posted history is NOT moved: MUST 3.18.4.3 step 3 and MUST 3.18.7.1 make history immutable, so migrate_historical_postings=true is REFUSED with E_MERGE_HISTORICAL_POSTINGS_FORBIDDEN rather than silently rewriting journal postings. POSTS NOTHING — no JE, no GL math, no posting flag, no feature flag. Tier 1 FINANCIAL: builder STOPS at branch-proof; owner Neon-applies migration 202608060000; GUARD re-proves on prod.
